```{r message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

#plotting function

plot_standard_ests<-function(df,title,ylab,xlab){
  
  plot<-ggplot2::ggplot(df, aes(x=factor(df$Subpopulation), y=df$Estimate.P)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(fill=df$Subpopulation)) +
  geom_crossbar( aes(x=factor(df$Subpopulation), y=df$Estimate.P, ymin=df$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=df$UCB95Pct.P), colour="grey", alpha=0.5, size=0.5, fill = "grey")+
  # ggpattern::geom_crossbar_pattern( aes(x=factor(chloride_ests$Category), y=chloride_ests$Estimate.P, ymin=chloride_ests$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=chloride_ests$UCB95Pct.P), size = 0.5)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= df$LCB95Pct.P,
                    ymax= df$UCB95Pct.P),
                width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                position="identity",
                alpha = 0.5)+
  coord_flip()+ggtitle(label = title)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plot+facet_wrap(~Category) + ylab(ylab)+xlab(xlab)

}

```

```{r read in the data}

stream_df<-readRDS("outputs/Probabilistic_data_workup_2_6_25.rds")

#add the adjusted weight for ALL surveys (adj_weight/3 surveys)

stream_df<-stream_df |> 
  mutate(adj_wgt_all_surveys = adj_wgt/3)

stream_df<-stream_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename(latitude = LATITUDE,
         longitude = LONGITUDE)

#make a list of the available parameters
params<-stream_df|> 
  select(PARAMETER_NAME,UNIT) |> 
  unique()
```

## Condition estimates

```{r bap stuff, warning=FALSE}

#filter the data
metrics.sf<-stream_df %>% 
  filter(PARAMETER_NAME %in% "bap_biological_assessment_profile") %>% 
  mutate(standard_cat = case_when(RESULT_VALUE >= 7.5 ~ "Non-Impacted",
                                  RESULT_VALUE >=5 & RESULT_VALUE < 7.5~"Slightly Impacted",
                                  RESULT_VALUE < 5& RESULT_VALUE >=2.5~"Moderately Impacted",
                                  RESULT_VALUE <2.5~"Severly Impacted",
                                  TRUE ~ "error")) %>% 
  filter(adj_wgt_all_surveys >0)

#create sf object
metrics.sf <- sf::st_as_sf(metrics.sf,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
)

#run the spsurvey data
standard_ests<-spsurvey::cat_analysis(
  dframe = metrics.sf,
  vars = "standard_cat",
  siteID = "SITE_CODE",
  weight = "adj_wgt_all_surveys"
)

standard_ests<-standard_ests %>% 
  filter(Category != "Total")


plot_standard_ests(standard_ests,"BAP Categories", ylab = "BAP Scores",xlab = "Stream Miles")

df<-standard_ests

df<-df |> 
  mutate(Category = ordered(Category, levels = c("Non-Impacted","Slightly Impacted",
                                                 "Moderately Impacted","Severly Impacted"))) |> 
  group_by(Category) |> 
  mutate(Estimate.P_clean = round(Estimate.P, digits = 0))
  
plot_bap<-ggplot2::ggplot(df, aes(x=df$Category, y=df$Estimate.P)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(fill=df$Category),alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_crossbar( aes(x=factor(df$Category), y=df$Estimate.P, ymin=df$LCB95Pct.P, ymax=df$UCB95Pct.P), colour="grey", alpha=0.5, size=0.5, fill = "grey")+
  geom_text(aes(label = paste(Estimate.P_clean,"%",sep = ""), vjust = -0.1))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= df$LCB95Pct.P,
                    ymax= df$UCB95Pct.P),
                width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                position="identity",
                alpha = 0.05)+
  coord_flip()+ggtitle(label = "BAP Categories")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev)+
  labs(y = "Estimated % of Stream Miles in NYS",
       x = "Categories")+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(legend.position="none")
  

plot_bap
```

## Statewide pollutant loads

we're going to to the big ones BAP TP, TKN, chloride,ammonia etc. big ones

```{r workup spl, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

#filter these to > 2017 since we'll just run one set
spl<-stream_df |> 
  filter(PARAMETER_NAME %in% c("phosphorus",
                               "kjeldahl_nitrogen",
                               "chloride",
                               "ammonia",
                               "bap_biological_assessment_profile",
                               "nitrogen",
                               "nitrite",
                               "nitrate",
                               "habitat_model_affinity_score",
                               "dissolved_oxygen",
                               "specific_conductance",
                               "ph",
                               "primary_contact_recreation", 
                               "iron",
                               "nitrite",
                               "total_dissolved_solids")) |> 
  filter(adj_wgt_all_surveys>0) |> 
  filter(EVENT_DATETIME > "2017-01-01 00:00:00 EDT") |> 
   mutate(UNIT = stringr::str_replace(UNIT,"/","_")) |> 
   mutate(UNIT = stringr::str_replace(UNIT,"-","_")) |> 
  mutate(RESULT_VALUE = case_when(RESULT_QUALIFIER %in% "U"~ 0,
                                  TRUE~RESULT_VALUE)) |> #non-detects to 1/2 of the MDL
  mutate(parameter_full = paste(PARAMETER_NAME,UNIT,sep = "_")) |> 
  mutate(parameter_full = as.character(parameter_full)) |> 
  select(c(SITE_CODE,EVENT_DATETIME,NUTRIENT_ECOREGION,parameter_full,RESULT_VALUE,WIPWL,BASIN_NAME,latitude,longitude,mdcaty,SO,wgt,adj_wgt_all_surveys,adj_wgt)) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(SITE_CODE,EVENT_DATETIME) |> 
  # tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = parameter_full,
  #                    values_from = RESULT_VALUE,
  #                    values_fn = function(x) median(x,na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  distinct()

#create sf object
spl <- sf::st_as_sf(spl,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
)


#create function to do this
cont_ests_parameter<-function(df,parameter){
  df2<-df |> 
    filter(parameter_full %in% parameter) |> 
    dplyr::rename(!!parameter := RESULT_VALUE)
  
spsurvey::cont_analysis(
    dframe = df2,
    siteID = "SITE_CODE",
    vars = parameter,
    weight = "adj_wgt"
  )
}

#run these all

cont_ests_phos<-cont_ests_parameter(df = spl,
                    parameter = "phosphorus_mg_L")

cont_ests_tkn<-cont_ests_parameter(df = spl,
                    parameter = "kjeldahl_nitrogen_ug_L")

cont_ests_chl<-cont_ests_parameter(df = spl,
                    parameter = "chloride_ug_L")

cont_ests_nh4<-cont_ests_parameter(df = spl,
                    parameter = "ammonia_ug_L")

cont_ests_TN<-cont_ests_parameter(df = spl,
                    parameter = "nitrogen_ug_L")

cont_ests_nitrate<-cont_ests_parameter(df = spl,
                    parameter = "nitrate_ug_L")

cont_ests_nitrite<-cont_ests_parameter(df = spl,
                    parameter = "nitrite_ug_L")

cont_ests_DO<-cont_ests_parameter(df = spl,
                    parameter = "dissolved_oxygen_mg_L")

spl<-spl |> 
  mutate(parameter_full = case_when(
    parameter_full %in% "ph_pH units" ~ "ph",
    TRUE ~ parameter_full
  ))

cont_ests_ph<-cont_ests_parameter(df = spl,
                    parameter = "ph" )

cont_ests_iron<-cont_ests_parameter(df = spl,
                    parameter = "iron_ug_L")
# 
#not sure why this isnt working

```

```{r categories for spl}

spl_categories<-spl |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = parameter_full,
                     values_from = RESULT_VALUE,
                     values_fn = function(x) median(x,na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(phos_cat = case_when((
    `phosphorus_mg_L` > 0.075) & 
      (NUTRIENT_ECOREGION %in% c("7","14"))&
      (`bap_biological_assessment_profile_score_0_10`< 5) ~ "impacted",
    (`phosphorus_mg_L` > 0.030) & 
      (NUTRIENT_ECOREGION %in% c("8","11"))&
      (`bap_biological_assessment_profile_score_0_10`< 5) ~ "impacted",
    is.na(`phosphorus_mg_L`)~ "no_sample",
    TRUE~ "non-impacted")) |> 
  mutate(chl_cat = case_when(
    `chloride_ug_L` > 250000 ~ "impacted",
    is.na(`chloride_ug_L`)~ "no_sample",
    TRUE ~ "non-impacted")) |> 
  # mutate(amm_cat = case_when(
  #   `ammonia_ug_L` > 2000 ~ "impacted", #this may hae to be changed
  #   is.na(`ammonia_ug_L` )~"no_sample",
  #   TRUE ~ "non-impacted")) |> 
    mutate(amm_cat = case_when(
    `ammonia_ug_L` > 1000 ~ "impacted", #this may hae to be changed
    is.na(`ammonia_ug_L` )~"no_sample",
    TRUE ~ "non-impacted")) |> 
  mutate(tkn_cat = case_when(
    `kjeldahl_nitrogen_ug_L` > 2500 ~ "impacted",
    is.na(`kjeldahl_nitrogen_ug_L`)~ "no_sample",
    TRUE ~ "non-impacted")) |> #used AJ's paper
  mutate(bap_cat = case_when(
    `bap_biological_assessment_profile_score_0_10` >=5 ~ "non-impacted",
    `bap_biological_assessment_profile_score_0_10` %in% "" ~ "no_sample",
    is.na(`bap_biological_assessment_profile_score_0_10`)~"no_sample",
    TRUE~"impacted")) |> 
  mutate(nitrogen_cat = case_when(
    `nitrogen_ug_L` > 483 ~"impacted",
    `nitrogen_ug_L` < 482 ~ "non-impacted",
    TRUE ~ "no_sample")) |> 
  mutate(hma_cat = case_when(
    `habitat_model_affinity_score_score_0_100` < 60 ~ "impacted",
    `habitat_model_affinity_score_score_0_100` >=61 ~ "non-impacted",
    TRUE ~ "no_sample")) |> 
      mutate(nitrogen_cat = case_when(
        `nitrogen_ug_L` > 483 ~"impacted",
        `nitrogen_ug_L` < 482 ~ "non-impacted",
        TRUE ~ "no_sample")) |> 
      mutate(diss_oxy_cat = case_when(
        (`dissolved_oxygen_mg_L` < 5 | `dissolved_oxygen_mg_L` > 9) ~ "impacted",
        (`dissolved_oxygen_mg_L` > 5 & `dissolved_oxygen_mg_L` < 9) ~ "non-impacted",
        TRUE ~ "no_sample")) |> 
      mutate(spc_cat = case_when(
        `specific_conductance_uS_cm` > 1000 ~ "impacted",
        `specific_conductance_uS_cm` <= 999 ~ "non-impacted",
        TRUE ~ "no_sample")) |> 
      mutate(ph_cat = case_when(
        (`ph` > 8.5 | `ph` < 6.5) ~ "impacted",
        (`ph`>= 6.6 & `ph` < 8.5) ~ "non-impacted",
        TRUE ~ "no_sample")) 
# 
# |> 
#       mutate(contact_cat = case_when(
#         "primary_contact_recreation" >= 3 ~ "impacted",
#         "primary_contact_recreation" < 3 & "primary_contact_recreation" > 0 ~ "non-impacted",
#         TRUE ~ "no_sample"))

#limit to just 2018 version

spl_categories<-spl_categories |> 
 mutate(year = lubridate::year(EVENT_DATETIME)) |> 
  filter(year > 2017) #since we dont have much chemistry before then
  
spl_categories<-sf::st_as_sf(spl_categories)

#create sf object
spl_categories <- sf::st_as_sf(spl_categories,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"
)
```

```{r run cat analysis spl,message=FALSE,error=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
                             standard_ests_tkn,
                             standard_ests_chl,

                             standard_ests_spc,
                             standard_ests_habitat)

standard_ests_spl_all<-standard_ests_spl_all |> 
  filter(Category %in% c("impacted","non-impacted")) |> 
  mutate(Category = case_when(Category %in% 'non-impacted'~ 'Non-Impacted',
                              Category %in% 'impacted'~'Impacted',
                              TRUE ~ Category)) |> 
  mutate(Indicator = factor(Indicator, levels = c("amm_cat","tkn_cat","phos_cat","nitrogen_cat",
                                                  "spc_cat","chl_cat","diss_oxy_cat","ph_cat",
                                                  "bap_cat","hma_cat"))) |> 
  group_by(Indicator,Category) |> 
  mutate(Estimate.P_clean = round(Estimate.P, digits = 0))
```

##Relative Risk

Relative risk measures the relative strength of association between conditional probabilities defined for a response variable and a stressor variable, where the response and stressor variables are classified as either good (i.e., reference condition) or poor (i.e., different from reference condition). A relative risk value equal to one indicates that the response variable is independent of the stressor variable. Relative risk values greater than one measure the extent to which poor condition of the stressor variable is associated with poor condition of the response variable. https:\_/search.r-project.org/CRAN/refmans/spsurvey/html/relrisk_analysis.html

```{r}

spl_categories2<-spl |> 
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = parameter_full,
                     values_from = RESULT_VALUE,
                     values_fn = function(x) median(x,na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
   mutate(year = lubridate::year(EVENT_DATETIME)) |> 
  filter(year > 2017) |> #since we dont have much chemistry before then, and then we just use the adj_weight not adj_weight_all_surveys
  mutate(phos_cat = case_when((
    "phosphorus_mg_L" > 0.075) & 
      (NUTRIENT_ECOREGION %in% c("7","14"))&
      (`bap_biological_assessment_profile_score_0_10`< 5) ~ "Poor",
    (`phosphorus_mg_L` > 0.030) & 
      (NUTRIENT_ECOREGION %in% c("8","11"))&
      (`bap_biological_assessment_profile_score_0_10`< 5) ~ "Poor",
    is.na(`phosphorus_mg_L`)~ "no_sample",
    TRUE~ "Good")) |> 
  mutate(chl_cat = case_when(
    `chloride_ug_L` > 250000 ~ "Poor",
    is.na(`chloride_ug_L`)~ "no_sample",
    TRUE ~ "Good")) |> 
  mutate(amm_cat = case_when(
    `ammonia_ug_L` > 2000 ~ "Poor", #this may hae to be changed
    is.na(`ammonia_ug_L` )~"no_sample",
    TRUE ~ "Good")) |> 
  mutate(tkn_cat = case_when(
    `kjeldahl_nitrogen_ug_L` > 2500 ~ "Poor",
    is.na(`kjeldahl_nitrogen_ug_L`)~ "no_sample",
    TRUE ~ "Good")) |> #used AJ's paper
  mutate(bap_cat = case_when(
    `bap_biological_assessment_profile_score_0_10` >=5 ~ "Good",
    `bap_biological_assessment_profile_score_0_10` %in% "" ~ "no_sample",
    is.na(`bap_biological_assessment_profile_score_0_10`)~"no_sample",
    TRUE~"Poor")) |> 
  mutate(nitrogen_cat = case_when(
    `nitrogen_ug_L` > 483 ~"Poor",
    `nitrogen_ug_L` < 482 ~ "Good",
    TRUE ~ "no_sample")) |> 
  mutate(hma_cat = case_when(
    `habitat_model_affinity_score_score_0_100` < 60 ~ "Poor",
    `habitat_model_affinity_score_score_0_100` >=61 ~ "Good",
    TRUE ~ "no_sample")) |> 
      mutate(nitrogen_cat = case_when(
        `nitrogen_ug_L` > 483 ~"Poor",
        `nitrogen_ug_L` < 482 ~ "Good",
        TRUE ~ "no_sample")) |> 
      mutate(diss_oxy_cat = case_when(
        (`dissolved_oxygen_mg_L` < 5 | `dissolved_oxygen_mg_L` > 9) ~ "Poor",
        (`dissolved_oxygen_mg_L` > 5 & `dissolved_oxygen_mg_L` < 9) ~ "Good",
        TRUE ~ "no_sample")) |> 
      mutate(spc_cat = case_when(
        `specific_conductance_uS_cm` > 1000 ~ "Poor",
        `specific_conductance_uS_cm` <= 999 ~ "Good",
        TRUE ~ "no_sample")) |> 
      mutate(ph_cat = case_when(
        (`ph` > 8.5 | `ph` < 6.5) ~ "Poor",
        (`ph`>= 6.6 & `ph` < 8.5) ~ "Good",
        TRUE ~ "no_sample")) 

#write a function to do this
risk_spsurvey<-function(df,stressor,response){
  risk_df<-df
  
  risk_df<-risk_df |> 
    filter(stressor != "no_sample")
  
  #run the survey
  relrisk_list<-spsurvey::relrisk_analysis(risk_df,
  vars_response = response,
  vars_stressor = stressor, 
  siteID = "SITE_CODE",
  weight = "adj_wgt",
  xcoord = "longitude",
  ycoord = "latitude")
  
}


hma_risk<-risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2, 
                        response = "bap_cat",
                        stressor = "hma_cat")
#worked! now we'll do the rest of them
phos_risk<-risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
              response = "bap_cat",
              stressor = "phos_cat")
amm_risk<-risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
              response = "bap_cat",
              stressor = "amm_cat")
spc_risk<-risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
              response = "bap_cat",
              stressor = "spc_cat")
tkn_risk<-risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
              response = "bap_cat",
              stressor = "tkn_cat")
nitrogen_risk<-risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
              response = "bap_cat",
              stressor = "nitrogen_cat")
diss_oxy_risk<-risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
              response = "bap_cat",
              stressor = "diss_oxy_cat")

ph_risk<-risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
              response = "bap_cat",
              stressor = "ph_cat")

#bind them

risk_all<-rbind(hma_risk,phos_risk,amm_risk,spc_risk,tkn_risk,nitrogen_risk,diss_oxy_risk,ph_risk)

risk_all<-risk_all |> 
    mutate(Stressor = factor(Stressor, levels = c("amm_cat","tkn_cat","phos_cat","nitrogen_cat",
                                                  "spc_cat","chl_cat","diss_oxy_cat","ph_cat",
                                                  "bap_cat","hma_cat"))) |> 
    group_by(Stressor) |> 
  mutate(Estimate_clean = round(Estimate, digits = 1))

risk_all$Stressor<-dplyr::recode(risk_all$Stressor,
                                               "amm_cat" = "Ammonia",
                                               "tkn_cat" = "Kjeldahl Nitrogen",
                                               "phos_cat" = "T. Phosphorus",
                                               "nitrogen_cat" = "T. Nitrogen",
                                               "spc_cat" = "Specific Conductance",
                                               "chl_cat" = "Chloride",
                                               "diss_oxy_cat" = "Dissolved Oxygen",
                                               "ph_cat" = "pH",
                                               "bap_cat" = "BAP Score",
                                               "hma_cat" = "Habitat Score")




#plot them!!

plot_risk<-risk_all |> 
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x=risk_all$Stressor,
                                         y=risk_all$Estimate)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",fill ="#233F2B") +
  geom_crossbar( aes(x=Stressor, y=Estimate, ymin=LCB95Pct, ymax=UCB95Pct), colour="grey", alpha=0.5, size=0.5, fill = "grey")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= LCB95Pct,
                    ymax= UCB95Pct),
                width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                position="identity",
                alpha = 0.05)+
  geom_text(aes(label = Estimate_clean, vjust = -0.1))+
  coord_flip()+ggtitle(label = "Relative Risk")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  labs(y = "Relative Risk Factor",
       x = "")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "#FACE00", width = 0.1)+
  theme_minimal()
plot_risk

```

## Attributable risk

Attributable risk values close to zero indicate that removing the stressor variable will have little or no impact on the probability that the response variable is in poor condition. Attributable risk values close to one indicate that removing the stressor variable will result in extensive reduction of the probability that the response variable is in poor condition. https://search.r-project.org/CRAN/refmans/spsurvey/html/attrisk_analysis.html

```{r}
try<-spl_categories2 |> 
  filter(nitrogen_cat != "no_sample")

attrisk_spl<-spsurvey::attrisk_analysis(try,
  vars_response = "bap_cat",
  vars_stressor = "nitrogen_cat", 
  siteID = "SITE_CODE",
  weight = "adj_wgt",
  xcoord = "longitude",
  ycoord = "latitude")


#write a function to do this
attrib_risk_spsurvey<-function(df,stressor,response){
  risk_df<-df
  
  risk_df<-risk_df |> 
    filter(response != "no_sample") |> 
    filter(stressor != "no_sample")
  
  #run the survey
  relrisk_list<-spsurvey::attrisk_analysis(risk_df,
  vars_response = response,
  vars_stressor = stressor, 
  siteID = "SITE_CODE",
  weight = "adj_wgt",
  xcoord = "longitude",
  ycoord = "latitude")
  
}

hma_attrib_risk<-attrib_risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
                        response = "bap_cat",
                        stressor = "hma_cat")

tkn_attrib_risk<-attrib_risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
                        response = "bap_cat",
                        stressor = "tkn_cat")
nitrogen_attrib_risk<-attrib_risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
                        response = "bap_cat",
                        stressor = "nitrogen_cat")
diss_oxy_attrib_risk<-attrib_risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
                        response = "bap_cat",
                        stressor = "diss_oxy_cat")
ph_attrib_risk<-attrib_risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
                        response = "bap_cat",
                        stressor = "ph_cat")
phos_attrib_risk<-attrib_risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
                        response = "bap_cat",
                        stressor = "phos_cat")
amm_attrib_risk<-attrib_risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
                        response = "bap_cat",
                        stressor = "amm_cat")
spc_attrib_risk<-attrib_risk_spsurvey(df = spl_categories2,
                        response = "bap_cat",
                        stressor = "spc_cat")

attrib_risk_all<-rbind(hma_attrib_risk,tkn_attrib_risk,nitrogen_attrib_risk,
                       diss_oxy_attrib_risk,ph_attrib_risk,phos_attrib_risk,
                       amm_attrib_risk,spc_attrib_risk)


attrib_risk_all<-attrib_risk_all |> 
    mutate(Stressor = factor(Stressor, levels = c("amm_cat","tkn_cat","phos_cat","nitrogen_cat",
                                                  "spc_cat","chl_cat","diss_oxy_cat","ph_cat",
                                                  "bap_cat","hma_cat"))) |> 
    group_by(Stressor) |> 
  mutate(Estimate_clean = round(Estimate*100, digits = 1))

attrib_risk_all$Stressor<-dplyr::recode(attrib_risk_all$Stressor,
                                               "amm_cat" = "Ammonia",
                                               "tkn_cat" = "Kjeldahl Nitrogen",
                                               "phos_cat" = "T. Phosphorus",
                                               "nitrogen_cat" = "T. Nitrogen",
                                               "spc_cat" = "Specific Conductance",
                                               "chl_cat" = "Chloride",
                                               "diss_oxy_cat" = "Dissolved Oxygen",
                                               "ph_cat" = "pH",
                                               "bap_cat" = "BAP Score",
                                               "hma_cat" = "Habitat Score")

plot_attrib_risk<-attrib_risk_all |> 
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x=Stressor,y=Estimate*100)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity",fill ="#233F2B") +
  geom_crossbar( aes(x=Stressor, y=Estimate *100, ymin=LCB95Pct*100, ymax=UCB95Pct*100), colour="grey", alpha=0.5, size=0.5, fill = "grey")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= LCB95Pct,
                    ymax= UCB95Pct),
                width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                position="identity",
                alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_text(aes(label = paste(Estimate_clean,"%",sep = ""), vjust = -0.1))+
  coord_flip()+ggtitle(label = "Attributable Risk")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  labs(y = "Attributable Risk",
       x = "")+
```

```{r, fig.width= 5, fig.height=3}
viols<-readRDS("outputs/violation_data_probabilistic.RDS")

  filter(date > "2017-01-01") |> 
  select(seg_id,site_id,attaining_wqs,parameter,result,adj_wgt) |> 
  distinct()

#merge in the locational data

  select(site_id = SITE_CODE,latitude,longitude,adj_wgt_all_surveys) |> 
  distinct()

cat_viols.sf<-merge(cat_viol,location,
                    by = "site_id")

cat_viols.sf <-cat_viols.sf |> 
  filter(!is.na(attaining_wqs),
         adj_wgt_all_surveys >0) |> 
  mutate(attaining_wqs = case_when(
    attaining_wqs %in% "yes"~ "No violations",
    attaining_wqs %in% "no" ~ "Violations Present",
    attaining_wqs %in% "threshold_data_absent" ~ "Threshold data absent",
    TRUE ~ attaining_wqs
  ))

cat_viols_all<-cat_viols.sf |> 
  group_by(site_id,parameter) |> 
  mutate(count = n()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  select(-c(parameter,result,adj_wgt_all_surveys)) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(site_id,attaining_wqs) |> 
  mutate(count = sum(count)) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = attaining_wqs,
                     values_from = count) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  mutate(final_wqs= case_when(`Violations Present` > 0 ~ "Violations Present",
    (is.na(`Violations Present`) & `No violations` > 0)~ "No violations",
```
